newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy firms, HRW wheat basis down.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy firms, HRW wheat basis down.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf nearby soybean basis values rose on Monday while hard red winter wheat prices fell, weighed down by harvest pressure, dealers said.
Export demand was also sluggish amid slow activity, they said.
Corn was mostly steady amid limited farmer selling, one dealer said.
Another dealer said several southern states including Arkansas were beginning to harvest soft red winter wheat and some Plains states like Texas and Oklahoma were harvesting hard red winter wheat.
